## STAR stories
> Title + one line each. Expand out loud in the interview, not on paper.

1. **Webhook retry queue:** — cut payment webhook failures from 2.1% to 0.4% with an idempotent retry queue (Go, AWS SQS) at Moneta Pay (themes: pressure, initiative)
2. **Dashboard latency:** — cut the merchant dashboard API p95 38% (450ms to 280ms) with query optimization and Redis caching (themes: initiative)
3. **Dispatch reporting automation:** — automated manual dispatch reporting at Kargo Systems, saving the ops team about 10 hours a week (themes: initiative)
